summary: Master tourism automation and service robotics. Learn to implement RPA, AMRs, and AI-driven guest systems to optimize operations and ROI. Enroll today.
lede: Automation in travel and hospitality uses software and robots to streamline operational tasks and guest services. For tourism and hospitality professionals planning technology integration, the course covers identifying automation opportunities, mapping robotic process automation workflows, and designing guest services that combine staff and robots, including room-service and concierge interactions.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the digital and operational evolution of tourism and hospitality assets.
modules: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) in Back-Office Operations
Service Robotics and Guest Interaction Design
Data Governance and Cybersecurity in Automation
Strategic Vendor Selection and ROI Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in tourism or hospitality management. Familiarity with basic Property Management Systems (PMS) or digital marketing tools is recommended. No prior coding or robotics engineering knowledge is required.
